anatomyHash.description: Fingerprint (12 hex) of the master's anatomy as read from Figma: component key, variant axes, properties, bound tokens and nested children. Written by ds-sync; no dates, so the same master yields the same hash. The verification protocol copies it into verification.figmaVersion.

verification.description: Whether this contract (CSS + .md) has been checked against its Figma master, variant by variant, following design.md § Verificación contra el maestro. Written by the person or agent who verifies; ds-sync keeps it and flips it to 'stale' when anatomyHash changes or the master disappears. Missing block = unverified.

figmaVersion.description: meta.anatomyHash at the time of verification.

lifecycle.description: Estado de vida del componente. Se rellena desde schemas/governance/lifecycle.json; 'active' si no hay entrada.

since.description: Fecha ISO en que se marcó obsoleto.

removeIn.description: Versión del DS en la que desaparece.

replacement.description: Slug del sustituto, o null si no lo hay.

docs.description: Where the hand-written criteria of this contract live: purpose, accessibility, when to use and what it does not do. They live only there; the schema points, it does not copy.

file.description: Path from the project root to the contract's own file: design-system/docs/components/<slug>.md or design-system/docs/patterns/<slug>.md.

section.description: Exact text of the '### <Nombre>' heading, without the sync date that follows it.

classes.description: CSS classes that realize this component in components.css (block, elements, modifiers).

example.description: Minimal HTML snippet using the real classes, mirrored from the 'Ejemplo de código' of the .md contract. null only if the component has no HTML realization yet.

properties.description: Figma component properties, read from componentPropertyDefinitions. One entry per property, never only the names.

defaultComponent.description: INSTANCE_SWAP only: resolved name of the default component (e.g. 'Icon / arrow right').

variants.description: Variant axes: { axis: [values] } as read from variantGroupProperties.

nestedInstances.description: Every INSTANCE inside the default variant, visible or not. Empty array only if the component contains no instances.

exposedAs.description: Name of the INSTANCE_SWAP property that controls it, or null if not exposed.

toggledBy.description: Name of the BOOLEAN property that shows/hides it, or null.

icons.description: Explicit icon summary so an agent never misses that a component carries an icon.

unexposedIconLayers.description: Icon instances without an INSTANCE_SWAP property — audit finding.

accessibility.description: Cómo percibe y opera este componente quien no lo ve. El contraste AA es condición necesaria y no suficiente: un lector de pantalla no navega por color. Opcional en el schema para no invalidar contratos anteriores, obligatorio en la práctica (política screen-reader-spec).

role.description: Rol semántico: button, textbox, checkbox, dialog, alert, navigation… 'none' si es decorativo.

name.description: De dónde sale el nombre accesible: del texto visible, de una etiqueta asociada o de un atributo explícito. Un icono sin texto SIEMPRE necesita nombre explícito.

announcedStates.description: Qué se anuncia al cambiar de estado: seleccionado, expandido, inválido, ocupado, deshabilitado. Un estado que solo se ve por color no existe para quien no ve.

keyboard.description: Qué teclas lo operan y qué hace cada una. Si no se puede usar sin ratón, no está terminado.

focus.description: Dónde entra el foco, dónde sale y si queda atrapado a propósito (modales).

readingOrder.description: Orden en que se leen sus partes, si no coincide con el visual.

hidden.description: Partes que deben ocultarse al lector por ser decorativas o redundantes.

platforms.description: Equivalencia por plataforma cuando el producto no es solo web.

contrastPairs.description: Pares texto/fondo verificados AA, en los dos modos. Lo que ya se exigía.

uses.description: Slugs of every component instantiated inside (one per nestedInstances entry, deduplicated). Icons included.
